snippet.title: Duck's Wrath - Trailer
snippet.description:
In Duck's Wrath you can face up to 3 friends in 2 different game modes based on pushing your rivals into the water by colliding or burping at them. Hot dogs will appear randomly every few seconds, you'll have to eat at least one to burp at your "friends". Let the best duck win!

Follow me on Twitter for development updates: https://twitter.com/guilemus_
Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1233790/
